title: Remove All Adjacent Duplicates In String
summary: Given a string of lowercase English letters, repeatedly remove any pair of adjacent letters that are identical until no such pairs remain.
statement: Given a string of lowercase English letters, repeatedly remove any pair of adjacent letters that are identical until no such pairs remain. Return the resulting string, which is guaranteed to be unique.
constraints: Repeatedly delete adjacent equal pairs until stable.
hints: A new character can interact only with the current surviving suffix.
Maintain the reduced prefix as a stack.
Pop when the top equals the new character; otherwise push it.
The stack is stable after every prefix, so exposed chain reactions happen immediately.
editorial: The stack is stable after every prefix, so exposed chain reactions happen immediately.
